newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers drop, while much of Europe rises.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers drop, while much of Europe rises.

text.p: ARA bunker prices fell by around $4 a tonne as the barge market sagged, while prices in many ports in Europe gained.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $96/$97 fob as the barge market shed around $3 in late morning.
Total ARA bunker volume was at least 15,000 tonnes, although not all suppliers were able to benefit as one of the enquiries was for 7,000 tonnes.
"Although a number of players were out of the market, the volume has been pretty good," one supplier said.
Meanwhile, prices elsewhere in Europe firmed.
Hamburg bunkers were around $3 higher than at Monday's close.
Mediterranean prices were up by around $2 a tonne. Enquiry levels in most ports were low.
